definition: a nobleman of the lowest rank
description: In a grand hall with a crystal chandelier, tall windows and gold-framed portraits, a young man in a black tailcoat, white bow tie, a wide blue sash and a gold star medal stands at the top of red-carpeted marble stairs and calmly leans forward to reach for a silver tray held out by a young maid in a black dress and white apron, who holds up a glass. Guests in evening gowns, long gloves and suits watch from below in shock.
